Neither an index nor a summary replaces a payload.
exact_artifact_packaging.bindings: evidence-manifest.json for implementation/QA/reviewer containers lists every logical member path, exact byte length and SHA256 plus actual container hash/bytes. Each run artifact-index.json lists every exact scalar/container deliverable and every member path/hash/length in targets.tar.gz,controls.tar.gz,checkpoints.tar.gz,spill.tar.gz. Its own digest is bound externally by the enclosing receipt/archive. Independently decompress and verify complete membership and all payload hashes before declaring an archive complete. Containers do not contain themselves or their newly introduced external container manifest; those packaging files are bound by the enclosing exact artifact receipt. This prevents recursive/self-hash requirements without omitting any original logical raw payload.

run_containers.targets.tar.gz: The complete logical targets/ subtree: all ordinary and matched-null target files, all3repetitions and all methods, full raw matrices/witnesses/roots/recovery/checker and generation/failure bytes.
run_containers.controls.tar.gz: The complete logical controls/ subtree, including every applicable synthetic, identity, source-interpretation, matched-null and group-edge slot and unavailable/failed dispositions.
run_containers.checkpoints.tar.gz: Every checkpoint needed to reproduce or resume any claimed portion of a run; a real empty container if none.
run_containers.spill.tar.gz: Every retained or reconstructively necessary spill payload, including exact matrix/witness data otherwise absent from scalar outputs. Store all bytes required by the original obligation before deleting scratch; spill-index.json alone never suffices.

exact_artifact_packaging.stage_containers: The implementation diagnostics/ and QA/reviewer raw/ scopes keep their existing exclusive write prefixes. Their exact evidence.tar.gz plus evidence-manifest.json deliverables preserve every intended raw file losslessly before any cleanup. No new outside write scope is granted.
exact_artifact_packaging.scope: Administrative artifact packaging only. All scientific definitions, algorithms, fields,342ordinary targets,360chart systems,8RUN units, controls/counts,3repetitions, budgets, thresholds, costs, source-interpretation revise disposition and required independent review are unchanged.

prepublication_administrative_correction.scope: Exact artifact packaging and direct-review dependency correction only; no scientific scope, approval or outcome change.
